title: WHEN TOM EATS KIMCHI: Evaluating Cultural Bias of Multimodal Large Language Models in Cultural Mixture Contexts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the accuracy of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) on Country Identification and Cultural Marker Identification tasks using images of food, festivals, and clothing, and measuring performance disparities between high-resource and low-resource cultures.

Using image inpainting to synthesize counterfactual images where the human subject's ethnicity is altered (to African, Caucasian, East Asian, or South Asian) to measure if the model's recognition of cultural objects degrades when the person's ethnic phenotype mismatches the cultural marker's origin.
